name: Pediculosis pubis
advice: Treat sexual partners at the same time. Wash clothes, towels and bedding in hot water (or seal in a bag for 2 weeks). Get screened for other STIs (HIV, VDRL). Recheck after 1 week; repeat treatment if lice or live nits are still seen.

rx.instr: If topical fails or widespread hair-bearing involvement; avoid in pregnancy / <15 kg

Eyelash involvement only — smothers lice; remove nits with forceps
